title: Pythia-70M: equal-norm packet controls and direction-by-checkpoint interventions
model: EleutherAI/pythia-70m standard published seed; pinned checkpoints 512, 1000, 8000
coordinate_policy: Original C-order QKV, block 3, head 6 Q/K, flat interval [589824,655360). No permutation, alignment, training, padding, downsampling or coefficient truncation.
packet_definition: Orthonormal Haar packet: a=(even+odd)/sqrt(2), d=(even-odd)/sqrt(2), recursively in path order. Each depth-six group has 1024 coefficients and reconstructs 65536 native weights. Path order is tree order, not monotonic Fourier frequency order.

directions.intervention: theta_s - lambda*v; positive lambda subtracts, negative lambda adds; baseline lambda=0

scan.paths: all 64 depth-six paths in the same native window
scan.direction: early, each rescaled to common norm

confirmation_selection: Before reading confirmation, lock prior selected aaaaad, sibling aaaaaa, canonical dddddd, largest-natural-early-norm path (weights only), and strongest scan path by repeated-query target NLL increase. Remove duplicate paths. No later reselection.
confirmation_interventions: For aaaaad, early and late directions both at the common norm, at checkpoints 512,1000,8000; lambda in [-1,-0.5,0.5,1], sharing the unmodified baseline
At 1000 and 8000, both early and late directions also at lambda=norm(L_aaaaad)/common_norm. This reproduces the natural late rollback magnitude and matches its norm with the early direction
At 1000, each remaining locked path uses its early direction at common norm, lambda in [-1,1]
input_separation: Scan and confirmation use disjoint token identities and separate original prose. Both exclude every random-prefix token ID used in the previous causality phase. No confirmation data consulted before selection is written and hashed.
probe_definition: Unique-token prefix S; query S[:-1] either repeated in order or scrambled. Target is the successor of that query token in the original prefix. Synthetic content-following, not a natural-language concept assay.
outcomes: Sequence mean target NLL and top-1 accuracy
First-pass NLL and attention to original successor
Original prose NLL, KL and argmax-change fraction
Final-query hidden state for every sequence
primary_contrasts: At step1000, selected branch versus sibling and the mean of the other 63 scan branches at equal norm
On independent confirmation, prior selected versus locked scan winner and fixed controls at equal norm
For the same direction and norm, compare its effect at 1000 and 8000
Within a checkpoint, compare early and late directions at equal norm
Direction-by-checkpoint difference in differences at lambda=1
uncertainty: 4000 paired sequence bootstraps stratified by length. Passage-level, token-weighted bootstrap for prose. Selected-versus-all scan contrast uses the mean of each sequence's 63 other branch effects. Descriptive 95% intervals, unadjusted; ranking is not a claim of statistically distinct ordering. Conditional on one model seed and these probes.
precision: Float64 projections of original float32 checkpoints; single rounding into float32 inference. Save applied norms, exact parameter restoration, all-depth reconstruction, and an independent direct-index full-forward scoring check.
budget: 100 or fewer intervention variants plus baselines; three CPU threads; no optimizer updates; stop after this fixed protocol.
